points.description: States that the water froze (turned to ice) AND that water expands on freezing, so the ice needed more space/volume than the bottle allowed, causing it to crack.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only one of the two ideas (freezing, or expansion/more space) is stated.

levels.says: Only one idea given: either the water froze/turned to ice, or water/ice expands or takes up more space, without linking both.

rubric.notes: Full mark for saying the water froze and expanded (ice needs more space) so the bottle cracked. Half for only one of these ideas. Equivalent wording is accepted; no marks for unrelated explanations such as the bottle becoming brittle with no mention of expansion.
